items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Mr. Broome found the same thing in Chicago. Yes, sir. [INTERVIEWEE] And you find everything that I tell you has been right.

ctx.x: Yes. Sit up in the lobby. They wasn't working. They'd sit up there and listen. Why would he almost cry? Well, because he was out of a job. Oh. And at that time when that music was changing and they had to have something to work that was before the record. After the record was out there, many of them came there. It's been said that many of these colored men preceded us up there. Because I don't know about that. I couldn't comment. But I can tell you one band that didn't precede us to New York. That was the Creole…
Well, Mr. Broome found the same thing in Chicago. Yes, sir.
And you find everything that I tell you has been right.
